sloka: धूम्राक्षेण समागम्य माणिभद्रो महारणे ।मुसलेनोरसि क्रोधात्तडितो न च कम्पितः ।। ७.१५.१० ॥
transliteration: dhūmrākṣeṇa samāgamya māṇibhadro mahāraṇe ।musalenorasi krodhāttaḍito na ca kampitaḥ ।। 7.15.10 ॥

translations.english: In the great battle, Maṇibhadra, having encountered Dhūmrākṣa, was struck on the chest with a mace by him in anger, yet he did not even tremble.
